# Visual Verifier

> Open-source anonymization QA for images and videos. Visual Verifier
> verifies blur, redaction, masking, and other visual processing frame by
> frame using deterministic PASS/FAIL, reviewed target coverage, temporal
> evidence, and CI-ready reports.

Visual Verifier is a local Python package and command-line tool. Media is
processed on the machine that runs it and is never uploaded; the package
has no networking dependency, and a test enforces that on every commit.

It is not an anonymizer. It is the independent test that runs after one.
Most tools transform visual media; Visual Verifier tests whether the
transformation actually happened, where and when it was required.

A pipeline can exit successfully while missing a single frame, or while
changing the frame but not the face or licence plate that mattered.
Visual Verifier compares reference and processed media frame by frame,
and when reviewed targets are supplied it checks those specific regions.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/): Product overview and quick start
- [Getting started](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/getting_started/): Install and run the deterministic demo with no clone
- [Anonymization QA](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/anonymization_qa/): Verification semantics and honest limitations
- [Target annotation](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/target_annotation/): Verify required faces, plates, or custom regions
- [Verification contract](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/verification_contract/): What PASS and FAIL formally mean in each mode
- [GitHub Action](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/github_action/): Use Visual Verifier as a CI quality gate
- [Use it in CI](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/ci/): Exit codes and pipeline integration
- [Benchmark](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/benchmarks/): Reproducible anonymization-gap benchmark against global metrics
- [Command line](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/cli/): Every command, option, and exit code
- [Python API](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/python_api/): Typed programmatic interface
- [Output schema](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/output_schema/): Field-by-field meaning of every report
- [Temporal tracking](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/temporal_tracking/): Association, lifecycle, and continuity metrics
- [Limitations](https://samtherocket.github.io/visual-verifier/limitations/): What a PASS does and does not prove

## Install and try

```
pip install visual-verifier
visual-verifier demo
```

The demo synthesizes a short clip locally in which a licence plate is
blurred on every frame except three, verifies it, and reports
`FAIL` with frames 4, 8, and 12. Nothing is downloaded.

## Exit codes

- `0`: verification completed and passed
- `1`: verification could not be completed
- `2`: verification completed and failed
